name: OVC Cross Country Championships
where: Cape Girardeau, MO · host Southeast Missouri
headline: OVC Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Southern Indiana swept the team titles at the OVC Championships in Cape Girardeau. The Screaming Eagles men scored 21 points to beat UT Martin (80), with Alex Nolan winning in 24:05.40 and teammate Jackson Nolan second in 24:10.70. The Southern Indiana women scored 34 to SE Missouri's 63, while Morehead State's Shelby Lamb won the individual title in 20:36.80.
